designationHistory.name: Cossatot National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1994 under the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act as Cossatot National Wildlife Refuge; renamed in 1997.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Overflow National Wildlife Refuge Located in southeast Arkansas in Ashley County, Overflow National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1980 to protect one of the last remaining bottomland hardwood forests considered vital for maintaining mallard, wood duck, and other waterfowl populations in the Mississippi Flyway.
